SCSI commands  0 new · 31 since boot
SCSI command errors (ioerr_cnt) count every command that ended with an error - also commands the drive or controller
rejects, such as SMART queries it does not pass through. Only new errors Tyr did not cause are a finding.
Kernel I/O errors are reads or writes the disk could not complete: check SMART (pending and reallocated sectors), the
cable or backplane (CRC errors), and journalctl -k for the disk.
